description:
"Lash an enemy with flame, dealing |cffffff8076|r Flame Damage.

Hitting an Off Balance enemy grants |cffffff5|r stacks of Volcanic Whip for |cffffff20|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff20|r seconds.

Volcanic Whip replaces this ability and consumes a stack to instead deal |cffffff15931|r Flame Damage to your target and all nearby enemies."
